title: Native shared terminal run context
description: Use the owned native device and private gateway with FARMSLOT_RUN_PROOF_FIXTURE. The actual terminal creates only its configured private idle shell on an existing tmux server. A real Clear key runs only after native process metadata confirms that shell has no child. Temporary tags restore and only the same verified idle test-created session is retired. No tmux server is started or killed.

proofTargets.claim: The slot's Terminal tab is the shared terminal: it resolves the run's pane from the canonical full-run observation, and an external write refreshes facts without restarting its stream.
A real terminal control key reaches the verified private idle shell through the current target.
A cold offline terminal restores the exact saved run timestamp; reconnect never replays its key.
An unavailable explicit actor is refused, never falls back to another target, and clears the actual previous pane buffer.

before.intent: Start the native device session before opening the actual terminal.

prove.intent: Prove terminal observations, safe keys, cold restore and exact actor pins.

shared.intent: Require the canonical run and updates without stream restarts.

command.intent: Require a real key through the verified private idle shell.

cold.intent: Require cold saved facts and no key replay.

pin.intent: Require real refusal of an unavailable exact actor pin.
